messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — ACME's procurement is pushing to sign a Dedicated pool this quarter. They want baseline 500 rps equivalent across EU-west, with APAC as warm-failover. Need sizing + billing sanity check before we issue the quote.
Josh Patel: 500 rps peak or sustained?
Maya Chen: They said sustained for business hours (09:00-18:00 CET) and 2x bursts for launch events. They care about tail latency <=150ms.
Liu Wang: For latency SLOs we'll want H100s in eu-west and keep A10Gs for APAC failover to hit cost target. Need conversion from rps->GPU units.
Clara Gómez: Quick back-of-envelope: assume avg request ~1.2k tokens, generation 80 tokens, avg seq len ~512-ish. One H100 sustained throughput ~= ~3k tokens/sec for that workload.
Josh Patel: If we translate 500 rps * 80 tokens = 40k tokens/sec. With prefetched KV caching maybe 1.5x effective efficiency.
Maya Chen: Can you paste a tiny calc we can share with sales?
Clara Gómez: Sure — rough calc:
```
requests_per_sec = 500
avg_generation_tokens = 80
tokens_per_sec = requests_per_sec * avg_generation_tokens  # 40,000
efficiency_factor = 1.5  # caching, batching
effective_tokens_per_sec = tokens_per_sec / efficiency_factor  # ~26,667
h100_tokens_per_sec = 3000
gpus_needed = ceil(effective_tokens_per_sec / h100_tokens_per_sec)  # ~9
```
Clara Gómez: So ~9 H100s to cover sustained 500 rps in eu-west with margin for latency. For 2x bursts we'd either reserve burst credits or prebook 9 more as burst capacity.
Ana Rivera: Sales note: ACME's procurement expects a 20-25% discount for a 12-month commit. We need a clean number to lock in pricing.
Ryan Cole: Quick billing note — last week we saw an invoice mismatch for a different dedicated customer where committed GPUs weren’t reflected because of region tag mismatch. I'll look for similar issues in ACME's test billing.
Maya Chen: That's what I wanted to flag — in staging they saw committed units on console, but billing showed only 6 GPUs applied.
Ryan Cole: I'll open a billing investigation. @deploy-bot can you dump the commitment mapping for customer acme-corp?
deploy-bot: Commitment audit for acme-corp: FOUND 1 mapping anomaly. Resource tags: [eu-west-1 (expected: eu-west-3)], committed_gpus_console=9, invoice_applied_gpus=6. Ticket created: BILL-4521.
Josh Patel: Nice find. Sounds like a region aliasing problem in our billing transform. Could be the eu-west naming change from infra migration.
Liu Wang: We should also re-run the capacity sim with degraded networking (inter-region egress higher latency) since APAC is a warm-failover. If APAC only has A10Gs, latency target might break during failover.
Clara Gómez: Right — A10G sustained tokens/sec ~1,000 for same model, so if we failover 100% traffic to APAC we'd need ~27 A10Gs (per earlier calc), or we do partial routing + degraded SLO.
Ana Rivera: Customers often accept degraded latency for failover, but they want explicit SLOs and cost math. Let's put both options in the quote: 9x H100s (primary) + burst pool (on-demand) OR 9x H100s + 27x A10Gs (warm) with lower discount.
Maya Chen: Action items: 1) Ryan to confirm billing anomaly and credit if applicable (BILL-4521). 2) Clara/Liu to produce small capacity simulation with network degradation scenarios and cost delta for warm-failover. 3) Josh to produce a one-pager for sales with GPU counts and pricing bands. 4) Ana to sync with ACME procurement on discount expectations.
Ryan Cole: I'll have a preliminary billing note by EOD and push any credit recommendations to finance queue.
Liu Wang: I'll schedule a quick sim run, need sample traffic trace from ACME though. @Ana Rivera can you get a 48h p95 traffic trace?
Ana Rivera: On it, asking their infra lead for last 48h p95 + spike days. Should have it tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Josh Patel: I'll start drafting the quote template. Will include a fallback policy: automatic cross-region fallback capped at 30% routed to APAC if networking cost exceeds threshold.
Maya Chen: Great. Ping me when the sim is in so we can confirm final GPU counts. Thanks all. :eyes:
